notes.title: Patch 1.2 is here!
notes.content:
It has finally happened! Patch 1.2 is now LIVE, and Azar is ready to face you in the arena.
We know it has been a while since the last patch and we were quiet, that because we were busy working on Azar and the other features of patch 1.2 alongside other back-stage things.
We will soon post an update on future plans.

[h1]Patch 1.2 Content[/h1]
[h2]Azar boss battle[/h2]
This foul creature was summoned by Ayziz's dark power straight from the fiery pits of hell.
Known for his minion summoning abilities and his sensitivity regarding his personal space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28585376/ea6f5d3c3c24056ba8a0e96ccea15b99139f81aa.png[/img]
[h3]Azar has the following skills:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Disarm Immunity - Azar is immune to the "Disarm" skill.
[*] Proximity Burst - Every few turns, if there are any adjacent warriors, Azar will emit a strong force from his body hurting warriors and destroying tiles in the blast radius.
[*] Meteor Shower - Every few turns, if there are no adjacent warriors, Azar will throw meteors around and on his foes, hurting the warriors and destroying the tiles in the blast zone.
[*] Raise Minions - Azar will raise minions to help him eradicate his foes in battle. The more minions there is the more damage resistant he becomes.
[*] Healing Touch - Every minion will heal Azar at the start of their turn.[/list]
[h3]Azar will drop the following gem shards:[/h3]

[b]First victory rewards:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tier 1 - 10 Fire shards.
[*] Tier 2 - 20 Fire shards.
[*] Tier 3 - 50 Fire shards.
[*] Tier 4 - 100 Fire shards.[/list]
[b]Daily victory rewards:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tier 1 - 5 Fire shards.
[*] Tier 2 - 10 Fire shards.
[*] Tier 3 - 20 Fire shards.
[*] Tier 4 - 40 Fire shards.[/list]
[h2]Leaderboard gem shards[/h2]
From now on, the chest daily reward you receive from your leaderboard rank will grant you gem shards as well!

[h2]Sudden Death Poison[/h2]
When the sudden death reached the final wave in battle, all warriors will become poisoned and will receive more damage each turn.

[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
We have added basic controller support that allows you to use your controller as a mouse.
Move the cursor using the joystick, and press the A/X button as left-click and the B/O button as right-click.
And of course, we added vibration :)

[h2]United States Server[/h2]
We received a lot of feedback from you about the lack of a US Server, so we added it!
You can choose your region in the options menu.

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
[h3]New Features[/h3][list]
[*] Added Azar boss battle.
[*] Added gem shards to leaderboard rewards.
[*] Added Unite States server in the regions section in the options.
[*] Added controller support - you can now use your controller as a mouse.
[*] Added another layer of security against code tampering.
[*] Added a new achievement - That's the evilest thing I can imagine: Kill your fallen opponent an offer after he offered the exact amount you counter-offered.
[*] When the sudden death reached the final wave, all warriors will become poisoned and will receive more damage each turn.
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3][list]
[*] Gem shards received from Boss battles will now be granted in the chest you receive.
[*] You will now gain or lose a 20% MMR score When fighting an AI opponent in a Brutal match, compared to a human opponent.
[*] Active Skills in battle will now show the correct reason they are disabled when trying to activate them.
[*] AI Opponents should be more reasonable when trying to haggle with them in the Mercy phase.
[/list]
[h3]Bugs & Technical issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] When the party leader leaves the party match, another player becomes the host and party leader.
[*] When the game disconnect while in battle, it will try to reconnect back as soon as the connection comes back.
[*] Fixed an issue where a Steam API AuthenticateUserTicket error would appear when entering the main menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where killing Dead Ned while a player is hypnotized would result in a defeat.
[*] Reduced the game memory usage.
[*] Improved the game optimization.
[*] Fixed minor translation issues.
[*] Fixed an issue where a warrior dying with Retaliate effect would result in a game de-sync
[*] Fixed an issue in the Single Player where the "Humiliation at its finest" would not unlock when it should.
[*] Fixed Rapid Shooter and Combo Attack de-sync issues.
[*] Fixed an issue where Combo Attack and Continuous assault being triggered together would cause a de-sync.
[*] Fixed an issue where your partner in boss battle would appear as an enemy.
[*] Fixed an issue where you could show mercy to a boss by waiting for the timer to end in the Mercy phase.
[*] Fixed an issue where the crowd throwing crowd buff would result in a game de-sync.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is here!
notes.content:
Brave warriors, 

We are happy to announce that Patch 1.1 is now live!

This patch adds the option to choose the server region from currently 2 options: 
[list]
[*] Europe
[*] Japan
[/list]
You can change the server region by entering the options menu, then the Languages tab (The globe icon) and at the bottom, you will see the server selection options.
By default, the server region is set to the nearest one.
Note: you will be able to play only with players in the same region, so in order to play with your friends on steam, make sure you are in the same region.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28585376/48ae3362bbe48458cb2d25f439a8c73363ce0970.png[/img]

We will add more servers in the future, so please let us know which regions you believe we should.

Also, we have added a party confirms system so whenever a party leader initiates a match search/fight - a dialog will appear to every party member asking them if they are ready to fight.

[h3]Gameplay[/h3][list]
[*] Added the option to change the server region.
[*] When inviting players to your party and they are connected to another server region a message regarding that will appear.
[*] Whenever the party leader wishes to start a match, all players have to notify him that they are ready.
[*] Added the option to remove a gem from an item with the Right-click menu.
[*] Leaderboard rank points are now determined by your opponents' matchmaking score (MMR).
[*] When receiving a counter-offer after begging for mercy, clicking the Beg button will now accept the counter-offer.
[/list]
[h3]Graphics[/h3]
[list]
[*] A '+' indicator will appear in the Appearance tab button and in the special cosmetics button when reaching Warrior level 3 for the first time.
[*] Added a message pop-up when trying to craft a gem when you don't have enough materials/glory coins with the specific reason.
[*] When having 2 active skills learned, a tooltip will appear when trying to learn a new one.
[*] Hotkeys indicators in the "Mercy menu" will no longer go over the offer received panel.
[*] When crafting a level 1 gem in the Jewelry, gem shards will show in the machine's blender.
[*] Unified all texts in the skills menu.
[*] Added a hint to skip the gem crafting animation.
[*] Fixed a graphical glitch in the options tabs.
[*] Fixed a graphical glitch in the "Mercy menu".
[/list]
[h3]Bugs & Technical issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players receive double daily chests
[*] Fixed an issue with certain scenarios in Dead-Ned fight that would lead to a game de-sync.
[*] Fixed an issue where a Warrior with retaliate dies with the Rise skill triggered when his opponent triggered combo attack would lead to a game de-sync.
[*] Blocked an exploit where you can bypass the weapon attributes requirement.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented upgrading a house perk to level 25.
[*] Fixed an issue where a player could send another player an alliance offer even after he died.
[*] Fixed an issue when dragging a gem to an item would lead to the gem getting stuck in the menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where a player can be in an alliance when there are 2 players left.
[*] Fixed an issue where buff created in the same spot of another buff would result in a game de-sync.
[/list]

Fixed minor localization issues.

notes.title: Announcing full release date
notes.content:
Dear Santa 🎄 

It is the time of counting days, down to Christmas - down to New Year! 🎆 
In this time of wonders, we started counting down too!
The count down to the release of Warriors: Rise to Glory!. That means we are soon exiting the Early-access.
Remember to grab the 1000 Shemekels pre-order bonus, because soon it runs out!

The planned release is on the [b]20th of January 2022 [/b]🗓️ Time to mark this date down.

[b]The 15th of December. [/b]
Why this date?

Like announced on Steam since the start, we will finalize the price of the game to [b]20$.[/b] 
It was meant to be on the release of the game, but we decided we would rather start with a sale, but Steam doesn't allow sales and price changes in under 30 days in between.

notes.content:
[h1]Patch 0.8 - Online Multiplayer in now LIVE![/h1]

Brave warriors,

It has been a long journey, after more than 2 years of cooking the Online Multiplayer, alongside the feedback we received from you - our amazing community, patch 0.8 is now LIVE with the Online Multiplayer game available for [b]ALL PLAYERS[/b]!

This path took longer than we anticipated but like everything we do here in Gavra Games, our gamers come first, and we want to give you the best gaming experience we can!

Here are the main key features added in the Online Multiplayer version:

[h3][b]Free for All[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28585376/4c4eee28bc6dad3148980c86fead507cedd1745b.jpg[/img]

Four Warriors will enter this arena to face each other but only [b]one[/b] will come out alive. Here, in order to survive, you will need more than your usual skills but also diplomacy and cunningness. 
Form alliances in battle and betray your allies at any moment you see fit.

[h3][b]2vs2[/b][/h3]
Team up with your friends and play 2vs2 team battles in the arena.

[h3][b]Co-op Boss battles[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28585376/01eb1236ff20d493781fcfab3ce3ac3b97911f1b.gif[/img]

Find a good partner and together try to bring down Indiekingdom's mightiest BOSSES in this co-op PvE game mode. Each boss has a unique skill set and fighting style. The challenge here is great and so are the rewards. Be careful, here, you either emerge victoriously or die and lose your warrior PERMANENTLY.

[h3]House[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28585376/95093c4a778bf0620dd97d8e093b6d4e95b26645.jpg[/img]

With each warrior who falls, another rises. Every warrior in your lineage will contribute part of his fortune and glory to permanently improve your House. This will strengthen your future warriors’ attributes and skills.
In the house, you will find 5 upgradable perks:
[list]
[*][b]Treasury[/b] - Everyone loves money, including your local merchant. Upgrade your treasury to permanently grant all your warriors a buffed bankroll AND extra glory coins from battle.
[*][b]Armory [/b]- Your underwear is infused with titanium, keeping you and your two best friends safe. 
[*]Permanently adds armor points to you and your future warriors.
[*][b]Weaponry[/b] - Cut! Slice! Mince! Dice! Hone your blade, grind your axe and sharpen your arrows to get permanent damage boosts that will send your rivals to their demise.
[*][b]Elixir of Power [/b]- This mysterious ooze bubbles with power and smells of permanent ability upgrade points. Just add the souls of the fallen and stir.
[*][b]Menorah of Might[/b]  -The secrets of the gods are revealed in this mysterious relic. With it your warriors will be granted permanent skill points to master all skills.
[/list]
[h3][b]Active skills[/b][/h3]
Among the various new passive skills we have added 12 new active skills to use in battles:

[b]Strength:[/b][list]
[*][b]Weak Spot[/b] - Reduces the enemy's defense and causes Light Attack damage/2.
[*][b]Iron Dude[/b] - Your blood test results came back! You have a lot of iron in your blood, making you invulnerable to all incoming ranged attacks.
[*][b]Uncrackable Nut[/b] - Using your inner strength, you've finally worked out how to grow a nut... It's HUGE and provides good cover. Reduces all incoming damage.
[*][b]Warrior Within[/b] - Perform a Heavy Attack with a 100% hit chance.
An attack so mighty that it concusses your enemy, making him even dumber than he already was and reducing his movement and damage by 50%.
[/list]
[b]Agility:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Back Stab[/b] - Teleport behind an enemy, ignoring tile movement and stamina cost and inflicting light attack damage.
[*][b]Retaliate[/b] - They won't push you around any longer! Every time an opponent attacks you in melee, you immediately strike back with a medium attack.
[*][b]Hot Shot[/b] - Fire 3 consecutive light attack arrows with a %1 hit chance.
[*][b]Fog of War[/b] - Unleash a poisonous cloud upon all nearby enemies, causing them to flee as far as they can from you and poisoning them for #1 base points(s) + %2 of your weapon damage.
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous [/b]
[list]
[*][b]Crowd Control[/b] - The crowd can sometimes be untrustworthy. Turn all of your opponent's hard-earned Crowd bars against him. Stacks with your Skills and Gems bonuses.
[*][b]Gimme some Sugar[/b] - It's Christmas time, and you've been a good boy. You and your teammate receive 2 random crowd buffs.
[*][b]Gavra Strike[/b] - Unleash your full Gavra fury! Deal damage based on your remaining stamina points. This action will drain all of your stamina.
[*][b]Disarm[/b] - You know kung fu! This special kick disarms your target, preventing him from using any attacks and inflicting light attack damage.
[*][b]Back Stab[/b] - Teleport behind an enemy, ignoring tile movement and stamina cost and inflicting light attack damage. Reduces the enemy's defense by %1 and cause %2 Light Attack damage
[/list]

[h3][b]Over 100 weapons and armors at your disposal[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28585376/e231ec7877750789700caad09ef92a02eebaeda4.jpg[/img]

A new arsenal is available for you to purchase in the shops:
[b]21 Axes.
21 Swords.
20 Bows.
42 Armor pieces.[/b]

Complete various daily challenges to receive rewards and gain XP to your house.

Compete with players around the globe and your Steam friends over the top rankings dominance, receive weekly treasure chests based on your global leaderboard position.

As the battle progresses, Deadly fire traps will start closing down towards the center of the arena. Stay clear of them, for they will cause a lot of damage!

[h1]Development Update 1[/h1]
Greetings mighty and blood-thirsty warriors!

First of all, in this apocalypse, we wish for all of our gamers to stay safe and keep playing video games. preferably Warriors: Rise to Glory!

Things have been quiet for a while, but it is not because we were sunbathing at the beach or playing Battle Dice all day. It is because we are working very hard to bring you the ABSOLUTELY EPIC CRAZY Online experience you ever had (No exaggeration here :) ).

We wanted to give you a sneak peek and some development updates about awesome things we are brewing here.

[h2]Multiple Warriors Arena[/h2]
Lately, we unveiled the "Bloodbath" arena - a place for 4+ warriors to fight until the last man standing!
This type of arena allows for a whole new array of strategies, collaborations, and Maneuvers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28585376/507767f7a2fbbf34c63bd57f400cd680b0da8143.jpg[/img]

We are waiting to see what kind of tactics you are going to come up with!

[h2]Player's House[/h2]
In the Online Multiplayer, besides upgrading your-always-dying warriors, players will also have a persistent upgradeable house.
After each battle, your house receives money and soul points based on the battle rewards.
With these, you can upgrade your house with bonuses that stay with you forever like:
[list][*] Increased damage for all weapons 
[*] increased armor 
[*] bonus starting warrior money
[*] bonus skills 
[*] attribute points for each new warrior.[/list]
The cool thing about these upgrades, they stay with you FOREVER. Unlike your warrior which you cannot get too attached to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28585376/04b2246c8d1f96a43c2cd68db7e2581032e01c35.png[/img]

We will expand more about the player house in later Development updates.

[h2]Lots of new things![/h2]
There a lot of new features and content coming with the multiplayer which we will unveil in future news.
For now, we can tell you there will be:
[list][*] New skills
[*] New Items
[*] New finish animations
[*] New leaderboard
[*] New jewelry screen - where you create new gems that stay with you FOREVER!
[/list]
[h2]Open-Beta release date[/h2]
So you must be wondering when will all the fun will begin?[b] So are we![/b]

We will announce the official Open-Beta release date in the upcoming months.

There a lot of new things, and we previously mentioned the highlights of this patch.
Now, as patch 0.45 is live – we can show you the whole content of the patch!

In the “IndieKingdom” we also celebrate Halloween! The town is filled with spooky stuff!
And in the survival mode you will fight endless pumpkin-head enemies (be careful not to become one of them…) Be sure to check it out.

Please welcome Russian and French players to the warriors family, as we added support for their native languages! This time, we went one step further and added culture-jokes for each of the languages. 
As you know we are constantly adding more content and languages as requested.  So if you would like to see your language in our game, please let us know in the forums!

We added some new quests that you can encounter between the fights!
These new quests are funny and have new and unexpected outcomes!
Look out for new variations for the existing ones as well.

And mainly, we added the “Rally the crowd!” action in combat.
As previously explained, whenever you excite the crowd you gain a “crowd bar”.
Gain enough crowd bars, and you can rally the crowd to turn the tide of battle to your favor.
This new action really makes combat more diverse and give additional weight to the “Crowd” fighting style.
If you gain 8 bars, something unexpected will happen!  

Beside that we have added survival leaderboard in the main menu, and as promised, a “hall of fame” screen where you can find all the players who finished the game.

notes.title: Patch 0.45 is on the way!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28585376/2e6d792ff0bc13f5ac038835bbbc3fe69cc1bb23.gif[/img]
[b]Greetings brave warriors![/b]

We know you haven't heard from us since the release of patch 0.44 (which added controller support, shields and more).
We have been really busy working on patch 0.45. At first it was supposed to be a simple patch, but as the Gavra way - we just can't settle for small things :)

In patch 0.45, we are going to include cool new features we have been working on. The main features are:

[u][h1]New "Rally the crowd!" Action:[/h1][/u]
For sometime you, our players have been telling us that the crowd needs to be more involved and have heavier impact in combats.
So we listened, and added a cool new action - "Rally the crowd!"
In patch 0.45 you can command the crowd to "Boo" your opponent, throwing  bananas at him and some other stuff (we don't want to spoil yet).

So how it works? when entertaining the crowd, you gain the normal crowd excitement, and with it, crowd bars. When you reach enough bars the action is unlocked. The more crowd bars you have, the higher the action level is.
[list]
[*][b]level 1[/b] - throw bananas, lightly drain your opponent crowd excitement and lightly damage him. 
[*][b]level 2[/b] - throw bananas, medium drain your opponent crowd excitement, medium damage him and root him to his current grid for 2 turns.
[*][b]level 3[/b] - throw bananas, Heavy drain your opponent crowd excitement, Heavy damage him and stun him for 1 turn.

[/list]
With this action, the crowd is more involved, and getting crowd excitement is becoming more vital. We hope you will like it!

[u][h1]Survival Leaderboard:[/h1][/u]
In patch 0.45 we are adding the "Survival Leaderboard" that will appear in the main menu. Whenever you finish a run in the Survival mode, your score will be uploaded to the global leaderboard. Letting you compete in global rankings! you can see the top 5 players and where you are standing against them.

This feature lays the first stone towards multiplayer and online components!

[u][h1]Hall of Fame:[/h1][/u]
We added a new Hall of Screen in which you can see every player who finished the final boss (Currently Azar - Molded by fire).
So when the patch is out - look for your name!

And of course, we are adding many more improvements (warriors can have a different color for the hair and beard), balance changes and bug fixes.

Patch 0.45 is going to be released next week, so stay tuned for news!

Until then - have fun and try to keep your nuts safe.

[B]Welcome, warriors! Sit down and relax.[/B] I said relax, guys – yeah, that includes your swords, axes, bows, and other tools of destruction, alright? Bloodthirsty Danny, would you be so kind as to move your knife away from that guy’s throat? I would prefer if you do not paint the floor of this tavern with blood, thank you very much. OK, now that everyone's civil and nice, we can start. 

We are working very hard here at Gavra Games to bring you a new update to Warriors: Rise to Glory!, and we’re happy to announce that it’s getting closer and closer. Today we want to reveal some of the new stuff included in next update. First and foremost: [B]we are implementing gamepad controls![/B] You will be able to play the whole game with your gamepad, so you will be able to entertain the crowds with your fighting skills while lying on the couch with a cold drink of your choice!

That’s not all, of course. We are also adding [B]some new shields for you to buy, equip, and fight with in the arena:[/B] spiked shields, dark elf shields, Roman shields, Samurai shields, and peasant Shields. If you have ever wondered what the hell are Romans and Samurais doing in the Indiekingdom, may I remind you that the emperor Ayziz uses his magic to bring here the best warriors from different places and times? 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28585376/4de08a63845d81276cc0f4b0104d451525fa1896.png[/img]

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28585376/eafb657455286889edb07955ed688395481bb07b.png[/img]

Greetings, brave warriors! E3 is always an intense week for gamers, and we hope you enjoyed the show with all its hype and excitement. We’ve been hard at work here – the mad emperor Ayziz does not wait for anyone, and he had us working really hard to get you more content so you could fight in Warriors: Rise to Glory! for his amusement and eventual death by your hands. Well, he’s likely not considering that last part – he’s mad after all, right? Anyway, [b]we’re happy to announce that Patch 0.43 will release on June 20,[/b] and it brings some new features and content for the game! 

[H1]KOREA JOINS THE FIGHT![/H1]

We will publish the full patch notes next week, but we wanted to give you a taste of it today. First of all: [b]Korea joins the Indiekingdom! Patch 0.43 adds Korean localization to Warriors: Rise to Glory!,[/b] and we’ve also added Chinese and Korean names, as well as improved the Chinese localization. Korean is the third language supported by Warriors after English and Chinese, and there will be more languages supported further down the road. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28585376/4ca4d74472ee92e19bc9a5008b8a48316fbb74e2.jpg[/img]

[h1]BEAT THE MIGHTY AZAR IN A NEW TOURNAMENT[/H1]

That’s not all, warriors! Patch 0.43 also includes [b]a brand new tournament with a new boss to beat: the mighty Azar, Molded by Fire.[/b] You will get a new achievement if you defeat him – but it won’t be an easy task, and to help you to achieve this goal, we have added [b]3 new weapons:[/b] the axe Apocalypse, the sword Arcane Justice, and the bow Last Whisper; as well as Dark Elf armors, available for purchase at level 9 and above. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28585376/2b11efb7cf0aedd6e5a6ff887f1131d28c2da090.png[/img]

Oh, [b]and the level cap is now at level 11,[/b] so you can be more powerful than ever! There’s also [b]a new title,[/b] The Thug, and you can now break the chest room because… well, because breaking things is fun, isn’t it? After all, you’re a warrior who kills people for other people’s amusement, not a museum caretaker! 

At the request of our community, we have also implemented the possibility of removing gore and blood from the game. Maybe it turns your stomach, or you just want to play in local multiplayer with your younger siblings. Whatever the reason, [b]you will be able to turn all gore off in the Options menu.[/b] 

[b]Patch 0.43 will include many other improvements, overhauls, and bug fixes.[/b] Stay tuned – and good luck in the arena!

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28585376/c69152eeb97e6baf66959b23186226f8161cd389.jpg[/img]

Greetings, brave warriors! The combat is over, the crowd has left, and we have some time to talk while the slaves clean the arena up and the victors walk away (or, in some cases, hop away) with the spoils to celebrate their triumphs. It’s been a while since we came here to update you on our plans… and that’s the point of this update, actually. We want to let you know that, starting from today, [b]we want to improve our communication with you, not only here but also in our Steam forums and social media channels.[/b]

[h1]A COMMUNITY FOR WARRIORS[/h1]

The whole point of our time on Steam Early Access is to develop the game hand to hand with you, receiving your feedback and trying to implement it in the best possible way, so the game reaches its true potential. That is not to say that we have not been paying attention, but we have realized that we can do it much better. Because of this, we will take a whole new approach, and we will do our best to be as available, open, and transparent as possible.

This starts with [b]a major overhaul of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/582330/discussions/]our Steam forums[/url][/b], so they are more clear, intuitive, and easy to use. Our social media channels, [b]both [url=https://mobile.twitter.com/WarriorsRTG]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/WarriorsRiseToGlory]Facebook[/url][/b], will be more active than ever – again, starting from today. And we would like to invite you to [b]our [url=https://discord.gg/MtRNVAQ]Discord server[/url][/b], which you can join by clicking this link. On top of it all, we will publish a bi-weekly dev blog, to let you know of our current developments and our next plans – sometimes there might be more updates if we think that there is something that we really have to say, but at the very least, you will find new content here every two weeks.

[h1]OPENING THE TAVERN[/h1]

And how will our social media channels, forums, and Discord server work? Well, [b]think of them as the tavern of the arena where the warriors meet after a tournament[/b]. It’s a place for exchanging combat tips, strategies, gossip – but also a place where they can talk with the managers of the arena (that is, us) on how to improve it! Every channel has its own peculiarities, so drop by and say hello to find out which one fits best your interests.

[b]We invite you to take part in the development process of this game along with us[/b]. Thank you very much for your continued support; we’re looking forward to talking with you on our Discord server, Facebook page, Twitter profile, or Steam forums. Now go out there and find glory by kicking someone in the nuts, warrior!

notes.title: Patch 0.42 is finally here!
notes.content:

We are happy to announce that Patch 0.42 is finally here!
Among many new features added, we are proud to introduce [b]“Survival Mode”[/b].
In Survival Mode, you play against endless waves of enemies. The longer you survive, the better your rewards! Including a scoreboard which will be part of our global leaderboard to come.
Survival Mode was requested by our community via our community HUB! So keep writing to us,
letting us know what you would like to see in our game next.

[b][u]New Features:[/u][/b]
[list]

[*][b]New “Mercy” animation[/b] cut scene is now available.

[*]Quests will no longer appear after visiting the tavern.
[*]Option to skip dice animation in “Battle Dice” mini game using the ESC key.
[*]“Critical Strike” now updates your chances in the “Battle Stats” menu.
[*]Confirm dialog when hitting “Stop” button in “Battle Dice” mini game.
[*]“Baffling Performer” Skill now makes your enemy waste his next turn.
[*]“Wounded Beast” Skill now works properly. 
[*]Added a special Chinese font.
[/list]
[b][u]Graphics:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]The tournament battle loading screen no longer displays retreat value.
[*]Fixed a very annoying issue where armor would become “out of sync” with the warrior in the main menu.
[*]The “Back” button in the tavern is now anchored to fit the canvas well in various different resolutions.
[*]Fixed issue where Warriors in Hotseat mode had their eyes closed in the pre-battle menu.
[*]Added 3 new tattoos:
[list]
[*]“MS13” – Available
[*]“Scary Clown” – Will be available upon unlocking future achievement.
[*]“Zombie Warrior” – Will be available upon unlocking future achievement.
[/list]
[*]Locked tabs in the character menu are now more distinguishable.
[*]Fixed Warrior battle avatars to match the full Warrior model.
[*]Warrior max size is now limited.
[*]Reset Attributes button now updates the “Battle Stats” menu.
[*]Fixed lighting in the main menu after changing the option screen.
[*]Main menu is now open when starting a new character.
[*]“Battle Stats” no longer appears in the main menu.
[*]Warriors in the Hotseat loading screen now appear on their starting side.
Technical:
[*]Improved overall performance of the game.
[*]Added Lighting Quality option in the options screen.
[*]Added “Window Mode” in the options screen.
[/list]
[b][u]Bug Fixes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where the additional turn granted by “On Guard” Skill was time-limited.
[*]Improved distance penalty formula.
[*]Fixed issue where the dice in “Battle Dice” mini game would cause others to flip when returning to the bank.
[*]Fixed issue where “Spiked Defense” skill would cause both Warriors to die at the same time.
[/list]
[b][u]Sound:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Death music volume is now connected to the “Music volume”.
[*]Armor break sound would play multiple times when 2 or more pieces of armor broke simultaneously. 
[*]Fixed issue where pressing the “Shop” button would play as a double click.
[*]Fixed volume whenever the game loads.
[/list]

That’s all for now! Stay tuned for the next patch, which will include Levels 9–10 and a new tournament featuring boss “Azar – The Rock”.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.402 & Compensation for lost progress
notes.content:
Greetings Warriors!

As some of you may experienced during our latest patch we accidentally erased all previous progress made in the game.

After crying like babies for 6 hours and hitting ourselves with wooden sticks, we have finally come up with a solution to compensate those of you who have lost their progress during the patch.

[list]
[*]In case your character passed the first tournament before the patch, you will receive additional [b]20 Soul shards[/b] to your current character.

[*]In case your character passed the second tournament before the patch, you will receive additional [b]30 Soul shards[/b] to your current character.

[*]In case your character passed the second tournament before the patch, you will receive additional [b]60 Soul shards[/b] to your current character.
[/list]
And now for the patch changes.

[b][u]0.4.0.2 Hotfix notes:[/u][/b]
[b][u]Graphics[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Arenas background have been fixed.
[/list]
[b][u]Bug Fixes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where kicking “Dead Ned” into a fire trap would cause the game to freeze. (again...)
[*]Fixed issue where the “Dirty Shot” stun caused the game to freeze (we guess that really hurt).
[*]Fixed issue where an arrow was making a deflect sound when a warrior dodges it.
[/list]

That's all for now, keep letting us know of any bugs and other suggestions and once again, we apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: Early Access is finally here! Update 0.4 is up!
notes.content:
Greetings fellow warriors!

It has been a long and bumpy road, but we are happy to finally announce:
[b]This Friday, the 02.02.18[/b] the game will be published in it's early access phase and will be open for the public to purchase!
We want to thank you, our gamers who supported us along the road. Thank you for all the input and feedback, the great words which gave us motivation to keep going and all the players who believed in us and pre-ordered the game.

Thanks to you, we have added content and tuned the game's balance.
Update 0.4 is up and by so this is going to be the early access build.

This is only the beginning, we will keep on updating and expending the game,
but for that we are going to need your feedback. Every opinion matters!

[b][u]Update 0.4 Changes:[/u][/b]

[u]New Features[/u]
[list]
[*]Introducing “Battle Dice”! – a mini game you can play in the tavern between [*]your arena combats where you can earn extra coins! ($$$)
[*]Give your warriors their own unique titles! 
[*]Warriors now has Steam cards!
[*]Many new sounds have been added to the game.
[*]End game screen – Players who will finish the game will be forever remembered in our future hall of fame.
[/list]
[u]Changes[/u]
[list]
[*]You can now skip the post-combat sequence.
[*]Text bubbles appear less frequently.
[*]Additional information in the spoils of war tooltip
[*]Trying to sell a recently bought item will now show a confirmation dialog. 
[*]Maximum heritage coins cannot exceed your slain warrior’s pre-tax coins. 
[*]Forfeiting a combat will now result in losing the fight and leaving your fate in the hands of your opponent.
[*]Enemies with a higher level than your warrior will challenge you only when you are about to level up.
[*]Enemies are now aware of traps, careful not to get pushed to them.
[*]When a warrior is hurt from “Spiked Defense” skill, he will no longer trigger a hurt animation.
[*]When your warrior dies, he will leave one of his items to your next warrior.
[*]Dead Ned’s cutscenes has been improved.
[/list]
[u]Graphics[/u]
[list]
[*]Skills triggered during combat now have their own effect.
[*]Tournament fallen enemies are now more distinguished.
[*]When you reach 100% crowd excitement in the tournament, they will throw [*]roses at you!
[*]The cliff is now bigger in the loading screen.
[*]The arena darkens when you receive a soul point.
[/list]
[u]Balance[/u]
[list]
[*]The cliff boss has been balanced.
[*]Enemies in level 3 now have less money for items.
[*]“Eye of the tiger” skill is no longer triggered by kick attack.
[*]“Strapped up” skill is a now a level 3 skill, and give you a bonus of 1,2 and 4 arrows instead of 6 arrows.
[*]“Rapid Shooter“ skill is now level 5 skill and has a 35% chance to trigger.
[*]“Professional Bargainer” skill now gives a discount of 5%, 10% and 20% at the shops.
[*]Dead Ned can no longer use Kick.
[*]Buffs from the crowd now appear less frequently 
[*]Warriors Calculated Health formula has been improved.
[*]Enemies in the first tournament have less coins to purchase items.
[/list]
[u]Technical[/u]
[list]
[*]Game engine has been optimized and will now run at better frame rate.
[*]Loading times have been shortened.
[/list]
[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where the volume levels were resetting between duels.
[*]Skeleton avatar eye particles have been fixed.
[*]Fixed issue where the experience and soul bar tooltips were getting cut out of the screen.
[*]Warrior’s speech volume has been raised.
[*]Fixed issue where the price of an item would show incorrectly.
[*]Fixed issue with sound tab in options.
[*]Victory sound level balance.
[*]Starting weapon selector now works better.
[*]Fixed crowd money tooltip.
[*]Fixed dancing music issues.
[*]Combat indicators no longer have an offset.
[*]Warrior defeat cutscenes have been synced with sound.
[*]Crowd buffs that are in combat will now show properly. 
[/list]
